people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

people.name: Jeroboam
people.line: First king of the northern kingdom of Israel.

people.name: Nebat
people.line: Father of Jeroboam, the first king of Israel.

people.name: Solomon
people.line: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.

translations.web: When Jeroboam the son of Nebat heard of it (for he was in Egypt, where he had fled from the presence of king Solomon), Jeroboam returned out of Egypt.
translations.bsb: When Jeroboam son of Nebat heard about this, he returned from Egypt, where he had fled from King Solomon.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, when Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who was in Egypt, whither he had fled from the presence of Solomon the king, heard it, that Jeroboam returned out of Egypt.
translations.asv: And it came to pass, when Jeroboam the son of Nebat heard of it, (for he was in Egypt, whither he had fled from the presence of king Solomon,) that Jeroboam returned out of Egypt.
